Traveller.intro: Watch flexible travel dates and destinations. Traveller keeps measured prices and checks promising deals before notifying you.
Traveller.noProfiles: No Watch Profiles yet. Choose your airports, dates and travel preferences to begin.
Traveller.sourcesUnavailable: Traveller samples the selected window and destinations using enabled sources. Deal scores need at least ten independent days of measured comparable prices. Unconfirmed required conditions prevent alerts.
Traveller.name: Profile name
Traveller.airportHint: Three-letter airport codes, separated by commas
Traveller.maxFlightPrice: Maximum return fare for the whole party
Traveller.nightly: Maximum nightly price for all rooms
Traveller.hotelTotal: Maximum price for the complete stay
Traveller.costEstimates: Cost estimates for the whole party
Traveller.positioningHint: Format: VIE=150, VCE=120. Missing estimates remain unavailable.
Traveller.noChannels: Create a private notification channel in settings first.
Traveller.archiveConfirm: Archive this profile? Discovery stops; price history remains saved.
Traveller.error: The change could not be saved. Please retry.
Traveller.privateChannels: These channels belong only to your account. Secrets are encrypted and are never shown again.
Traveller.removeChannelConfirm: Remove this notification channel? Existing price history is retained.
Traveller.discoveryNotice: Active profiles schedule sampled broad flight searches. Sources may pause after errors or access challenges. Candidates require itinerary and fare-condition checks before deal alerts.
Traveller.noCandidates: No measured flight candidates yet. Your active profiles wait for available source request slots.
Traveller.candidateUnverified: Discovery candidate. Fare conditions and the complete itinerary are not yet verified.
Traveller.operationsError: Operational settings could not be saved. Reload and retry.
Traveller.weightsNotice: Weights must total 100. Confidence caps and minimum historical evidence remain mandatory. Currency conversions use dated reference estimates, not booking exchange rates.
Traveller.limit_google_explore: Partner-cached destination prices. Dates rotate through your window; coverage is sampled. The exact itinerary and fare conditions still require verification.
Traveller.limit_google_flights: Google aggregator confirmation has medium confidence. Dates, all segments, cabin, passengers and fare conditions must match.
Traveller.limit_google_hotels: Stay totals, occupancy, taxes, review counts and room conditions must be confirmed before hotel qualification.
Traveller.limit_booking: Unattended access may be blocked. Requests stop on access challenges; no CAPTCHA bypass.
Traveller.limit_airline_direct: Only explicitly supported airline contexts can confirm a fare. An airline link alone provides no verification.
Traveller.limit_community: Community observations require a recheck. Private Traveller queries are never published to the hub.
Traveller.limit_skyscanner_api: Unavailable official integration. Approved access is required; this service is never mandatory.
Traveller.invalidFilters: Check the filter values. A price limit requires a currency.
Traveller.selectedItinerary: Selected round trip checked against Google Flights
Traveller.priceExpired: This recorded fare has expired. Open the provider to confirm a current price before booking.
Traveller.referenceEstimate: Reference estimate: {amount} · {source} · {date}. The booking price remains in its original currency.
Traveller.localHotelDates: Hotel stay in destination local dates
Traveller.googleConfidenceNotice: Google Explore and Google Flights are one underlying source. A selected fare check provides medium confidence; independent or direct evidence is needed for high confidence. Cached information may change before booking.

eligibilityReasons.stops: Stops exceed the limit or remain unknown
eligibilityReasons.duration: Flight duration exceeds the limit or remains unknown
eligibilityReasons.baggage: Required checked baggage is not confirmed
eligibilityReasons.self_transfer_unconfirmed: A single protected booking is not confirmed
eligibilityReasons.overnight_unconfirmed: Overnight connection conditions are not confirmed
eligibilityReasons.layovers: Connection duration falls outside the permitted range
eligibilityReasons.airlines_airports_unconfirmed: Airlines and connecting airports are not confirmed
eligibilityReasons.excluded_airline: An excluded airline operates a segment
eligibilityReasons.preferred_airline: No preferred airline operates this itinerary
eligibilityReasons.excluded_airport: The itinerary uses an excluded airport
eligibilityReasons.positioning_unavailable: A positioning cost is needed for this departure airport
eligibilityReasons.missing_or_invalid_quality: Hotel rating, review count or official stars are not confirmed
eligibilityReasons.quality_threshold: Hotel quality does not meet the profile requirements
eligibilityReasons.stay_allocation: Room or stay allocation does not match
eligibilityReasons.hotel_price: Full hotel stay exceeds the budget
eligibilityReasons.hotel_nightly_price: Average nightly price exceeds the budget
eligibilityReasons.breakfast_unconfirmed: Breakfast included in this rate is not confirmed
eligibilityReasons.hotel_refund_unconfirmed: Refundable hotel rate is not confirmed
eligibilityReasons.hotel_distance_unconfirmed: Hotel distance from the requested centre is not confirmed
eligibilityReasons.hotel_amenities_unconfirmed: Required hotel amenities are not confirmed
eligibilityReasons.hotel_type_unconfirmed: Required property type is not confirmed
eligibilityReasons.local_stay_duration: Local hotel nights fall outside the permitted duration

Traveller.saveLanguageError: Language could not be saved. Try again.
Traveller.inAppOnly: In-app alert; no external channels selected
Traveller.deliveryCancelled: Delivery cancelled: the offer expired or profile changed
Traveller.wholeTripTotal: Total for the whole party: flights, full hotel stay and positioning
Traveller.noTrips: No fresh, verifiable flight and hotel combinations yet.
Traveller.noSurprises: No measured eligible trip scores of 70 or more yet. Keep profiles active while comparable history develops.
Traveller.surpriseExplanation: Your private profiles, ranked by measured trip value. At most one result per destination; no invented fares or scores.
Traveller.tripConfidenceNotice: Each component must match the party and local stay dates. Google flight and hotel checks provide medium confidence for their own component. The combination is not an independently confirmed package.
Traveller.positioningEstimate: Estimated positioning cost for the whole party
Traveller.directConfidenceNotice: The airline directly confirmed the party total, passengers, segments, cabin and fare. Different marketing and operating flight labels are retained below.
Traveller.gmailSetup: Gmail: enter your full Gmail address and an app password (requires 2-Step Verification). Leave sender and recipient blank to send to yourself. Port 587 uses required STARTTLS; keep implicit TLS unchecked. Settings also support another SMTP server.
Traveller.alertsAccepted: Alerts accepted by at least one channel
Traveller.aiUsage30Days: AI usage in the last 30 days
Traveller.aiOptionalNotice: Traveller discovery and scoring use deterministic extraction. AI is optional; unavailable tokens or costs remain unknown.
Traveller.noAiUsage: No AI calls recorded in this period.
Traveller.providerReadinessNotice: Credential/configuration readiness; this does not prove a successful generation.
Traveller.regionFilterNotice: Regions use a confirmed destination airport. Unresolved destinations are excluded from a region-filtered view.
Traveller.measuredHistoryOnly: Measured prices in the displayed currency only. The table lists individual observations.
Traveller.channelTestSent: Test notification accepted by the sending service. Check your inbox or destination.
Traveller.channelTestThrottled: Wait 30 seconds before sending another test.
Traveller.channelTestUnavailable: Test sending is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
Traveller.channelTestFailed: The test notification could not be sent. Check your channel settings and credentials.
Traveller.channelTestBody: This is a test notification from your private Traveller channel. No travel deal is being reported.
